suggested_experiment_name: Axion dark matter from string defects (post-inflationary scenario)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis labeled |g_agamma|/GeV^-1
notes: This paper is a theoretical study of QCD axion dark matter abundance from cosmic strings in the post-inflationary scenario. It does NOT present measured or observed exclusion limits on axion couplings (g_agamma, g_ae, etc.) or on the axion mass-decay-constant plane (f_a vs m_a). Instead, it derives a LOWER BOUND on the axion mass m_a ≈ 0.5–20 meV required to avoid exceeding the observed dark matter density, assuming the post-inflationary PQ-breaking scenario with N=1. The paper uses numerical simulations of string networks and analytic calculations to estimate the axion abundance from string defects, but does not constrain coupling constants. The bounds quoted (e.g., eqs. 6–7 in Section 4) are cosmological/abundance constraints, not direct coupling measurements or exclusion limits from experiments. No data points in the standard (mass, coupling) format can be extracted.
